name: memento
description: Multi-layer cache memory base. L3 (sources) -> L2 (wiki) -> L1 (AGENTS.md) compilation pipeline with passive session capture (fin), active LLM-driven interview (ama), and lightweight queue review (followups).

interface.longDescription: Multi-layer local memory base. Five skills cover the full loop: memento-config (setup + ongoing config), fin (passive session capture), ama (active LLM-driven interview), compile (sources -> wiki -> AGENTS.md hot set), and followups (queue review). Supports a configurable Memento data root for global plugin installs.
defaultPrompt: Set up a memory base in this repo.
Compile my sources into the wiki.
Finish this session and capture useful context.
Ask me anything to fill in gaps in my wiki.
